full_details: Master Thwaite read the commination with relish and did not pretend otherwise. Mistress Ansell called the hardness right. The loaf is still a penny and a finger short. At the lodging the account book still says 1594 at the head, with the Queen's twenty pounds not yet had, and no new columns, and no total. At the Theatre the stage was cold. Ralph Raye had a Rose bill for Seleo and Olympo and had seen the flag up, and would not give a figure from a book he did not see. Kemp was bitter about three pounds. You said Henslowe would be shut within a fortnight. Evening prayer was the office, and not a second reading. At home the supper was fish at threepence, and you did not cross the river.
one_sentence: You heard the commination, left the account book headed 1594, and at the cold Theatre heard a flag on the Bankside and Kemp's three pounds.
title: The commination, and a cold stage
